repair_notes: Previous parser failure was resolved by structured XML table review: 14 peptide/protein rows x IC50/IC100 endpoints = 28 source-supported activity records.
The paper table reports IC100 for complete conidial-germination inhibition; database MIC labels are reconciled as crosswalk labels, not used to overwrite the primary endpoint.
Supplementary assets checked locally are HTML landing pages and TIF figure surfaces, not structured activity spreadsheets; no extra source-supported table rows were added from supplements.
